quest.title: Problem Conversion: Loading Capacity
quest.description: At last, Rafiq's design has entered its testing phase...

dialogues.speaker: Rafiq
dialogues.text: Traveler! You're just in time. I just launched the ship. It's steady as she goes, as they say.

dialogues.speaker: Rafiq
dialogues.text: My calculation worked out perfectly, just as I thought!

dialogues.speaker: Qishan
dialogues.text: So, when do we start this load test?

dialogues.speaker: Rafiq
dialogues.text: Let's not rush. The Traveler is here, so we may start soon.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What's a load test?

dialogues.speaker: Rafiq
dialogues.text: In a nutshell, we test the load capacity of the ship using heavy objects.

dialogues.speaker: Rafiq
dialogues.text: This means that someone is going to have to move the stuff onto the ship with me.

dialogues.speaker: Rafiq
dialogues.text: And you, Traveler, as I observed previously, are most able-bodied. Surely such a gig is a piece of cake to you...

choices.text: Oh, so that's why you asked me to come here, eh?

response.speaker: Rafiq
response.text: Well... Ugh, I can't do this on my own, so I could only ask you to help out.

response.speaker: Rafiq
response.text: There will be generous rewards, I promise! I just helped a guy fix his large ship days ago. It was a pretty well-paying job, too!

response.speaker: Rafiq
response.text: Eh? Uh, well, I did spend nearly all that Mora on the ship...

response.speaker: Rafiq
response.text: I still have some left! Don't worry, I can still buy you some coffee...

response.speaker: Rafiq
response.text: Well then, Traveler, let's get this started! To the ship!

dialogues.speaker: Qishan
dialogues.text: Huh? Is this ship really capable of carrying such heavy things...

talks.objective: Go back and talk to Rafiq

dialogues.speaker: Rafiq
dialogues.text: Alright! That should be it. Let's see what will happen...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Whoa! The ship's sprung a leak over there!

dialogues.speaker: Rafiq
dialogues.text: What!?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: The ship is tilting! What's going on?

dialogues.speaker: Rafiq
dialogues.text: Move the stuff off now! Something's gone wrong!

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: You rid the ship of heavy items together with Rafiq in a hurry...

dialogues.speaker: Rafiq
dialogues.text: Whew... We're lucky that there weren't too many things to move.

dialogues.speaker: Rafiq
dialogues.text: What the... Where did I go wrong?

dialogues.speaker: Qishan
dialogues.text: What did I say? The theoretical data you used is too extreme to be reliable.

dialogues.speaker: Rafiq
dialogues.text: *sigh* I... I... Fine.

dialogues.speaker: Rafiq
dialogues.text: This shouldn't have happened... I did my calculations with so much precision!

dialogues.speaker: Rafiq
dialogues.text: Thanks for your help, Traveler. Please take this as compensation for your trouble.

dialogues.speaker: Rafiq
dialogues.text: I'll go back and redo my calculations. Qishan, could you help me with them?

dialogues.speaker: Qishan
dialogues.text: You say it like I wasn't already helping before...

dialogues.speaker: Qishan
dialogues.text: Just leave it to me, and remember to buy me coffee after this.

talks.objective: Go back and talk to Rafiq

dialogues.speaker: Rafiq
dialogues.text: Yes! It worked out!

dialogues.speaker: Rafiq
dialogues.text: There are no structural problems with the hull... The waterline is stable, too. No tipping.

dialogues.speaker: Rafiq
dialogues.text: Look, Qishan, my design and calculations are immaculate!

dialogues.speaker: Qishan
dialogues.text: Don't get carried away. We're just at phase one of the load test.

dialogues.speaker: Qishan
dialogues.text: And you haven't even taken into account the center of gravity shift that will occur on the ship due to weather and cargo as it navigates.

dialogues.speaker: Rafiq
dialogues.text: Ugh... I'll consider those factors. But please, just let me enjoy this moment.

dialogues.speaker: Rafiq
dialogues.text: Oh, Traveler, this is your payment. Please take it.

dialogues.speaker: Rafiq
dialogues.text: Qishan, can't you just be happy for me once?

dialogues.speaker: Qishan
dialogues.text: But being happy for you isn't going to help you build the ship.

dialogues.speaker: Qishan
dialogues.text: Best you try to make your wallet happy instead.

talks.objective: Go back and talk to Rafiq

dialogues.speaker: Rafiq
dialogues.text: The load capacity of this ship is out of the question! Don't worry!
